description: Ministry of Labour and Foreign Employment - The Industrial Dispute between D.S.M. Wijesinghe Wettawa Dambadeniya and Other Part Commercial Credit and Finance PLC. Kandy
reasoning: This gazette content primarily deals with legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains orders made under Section 4(1) of the Act, including the revocation of a previous arbitration appointment and the appointment of a new arbitrator to settle an industrial dispute. The content focuses on statutory instruments and legal procedures rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
